Keep the finish looking fresh

Simple care tips for your paint, wheels and cabin between details.

Paintwork

Wash in the shade on a cool surface. Use a car shampoo and a clean wash mitt, then dry with a soft microfibre towel.

Wheels

Rinse loose dirt first and use a separate brush for the wheels so brake dust stays off your paintwork.

Cabin

Vacuum loose dirt before wiping surfaces. Spot-test any cleaner on an inconspicuous area first.

Before your appointment

What should I prepare for a mobile detail?

Check that car washing is allowed at your location. Clear valuables from the cabin and let us know if water or power access is limited.

How do I choose a package?

Pick Express wash for routine exterior care, Inside & out for the cabin as well, or Paint refresh when the paintwork needs more attention.
